# Sleep & Sinus Centers

> Board-certified ENT specialists in Northeast Georgia providing minimally invasive sinus and sleep apnea treatments including Balloon Sinuplasty, VOAT, and allergy care.

Sleep & Sinus Centers operates multiple locations across Northeast Georgia (Lawrenceville, Athens, Braselton, Gwinnett) and specializes in advanced, in-office procedures for chronic sinusitis, sleep apnea, allergies, and rhinitis. The practice emphasizes patient-friendly alternatives to traditional surgery and CPAP therapy.

## Key Topics

- Balloon Sinuplasty
- VOAT (Minimally Invasive Sleep Apnea)
- Chronic Sinusitis Treatment
- Sleep Apnea & Snoring

- In-Office Procedures
- Northeast Georgia Locations

- [Clear Path Sinus Relief](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/introducing-the-clear-path-procedure-your-shortcut-to-sinus-relief): Clear Path minimally invasive balloon sinus treatment procedure overview
- [Chronic Rhinitis Treatment](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/treating-chronic-rhinitis): Post-nasal drip and chronic rhinitis relief using ClariFix cryotherapy
- [Balloon Sinuplasty Success Stories](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/balloon-sinuplasty-testimonials): Patient testimonials and success stories from Balloon Sinuplasty procedures

## Allergy Testing & Treatment

- [Allergy Testing](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/allergy-testing): In-office skin-prick allergy testing and comprehensive ENT allergy care
- [Long-Term Allergy Relief](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/long-term-relief-from-allergy-pain): Personalized allergy relief using sublingual immunotherapy drops
- [Allergy Drops vs. Shots](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/allergy-drops-vs-allergy-shots): Comparison guide for sublingual drops versus allergy shots immunotherapy
- [What Are Allergies?](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/what-are-allergies): Educational guide explaining allergies, triggers, and treatment overview

## Patient Assessment Tools

- [Sinus Symptom Quiz](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/sinus-symptom-quiz): Interactive 1-minute quiz to assess sinus symptoms and congestion severity
- [Test Your Sleepiness](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/test-your-sleepiness): Epworth Sleepiness Scale quiz for daytime sleepiness self-assessment
- [Test Your Allergy Symptoms](https://sleepandsinuscenters.com/test-your-allergy-symptoms): Interactive allergy symptom assessment quiz for seasonal and pet allergies
